bagPolicy.summary: Ford Field follows the NFL's bag policy to ensure safety and quick entry. Fans should avoid bringing bags, but clear bags and small clutches are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags approximately the size of a hand
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Ford Field can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Ford Field's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Ford Field offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including local favorites like Detroit Spirits and Great Lakes Burger Bar. Special offerings include club-level exclusives such as Slows Bar BQ and the Detroit Bloody Mary Bar. Fans can enjoy a variety of cuisines from burgers and pretzels to Greek salads and cheesecake.
stands: Detroit Bloody Mary Bar Delta Club
Great Lakes Burger Comerica Gridiron Club
K & R Almonds Delta Club Cafe
Delta Club Cafe featuring Ben's Pretzels

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Ford Field, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ford Field's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Box Office Hours of Operation The Detroit Lions/Ford Field Gate G Ticket Office is located next to the main entrance of Gate G on St.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Ford Field. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
